window.note: THIS END STOPPED KEEPING ITS OWN COPY. _source_fingerprint is one line delegating to tools.base.validation.directory_fingerprint, _sealed_fingerprint_now asks the same front, and component_color hashes PER SEAL rather than once per component — the finding now carries scope= saying whether it judged N imported files or the whole directory (Law 7). COST, and it is a real one: per-seal hashing is ~700 file reads on a 36-proof component against ~40 before; that belongs to trouble beat-tail-re-walks-corpora-no-sieve-counts. THE RED THIS END CARRIED IS CLEARED, and by the ticket it was attributed to: test_inspector_nexus was red on fire_path_unreachable from commit 433cdc9's bus dial, was NOT triaged away, and ticket 9579a6f9cec6 removed the dial rather than the check — the sieve now reads 0 fire_path_unreachable and 0 device_isolation_holds on a full run, and the proof is green twice. The attribution held: a red carried on a named ticket is a red that gets fixed. || a seal now fingerprints WHAT THE PROOF IMPORTS, not the directory it sits in. run_proof runs the proof under an atexit+runpy wrapper that reports sys.modules' repo-relative __file__ set; the seal records evidence.fingerprint_closure and a hash over exactly that set. MEASURED: on cairn/tools/base's 36 sealed proofs a touch to transitions.py expired 36 of 36 under the old recipe and expires 15 of 36 now — 21 seals survive, 0 capture failures. Capture cost on an idle machine -0.029s/run (-1.7%), below run-to-run variance, against >=35.7s of re-seals saved per edit. Corpus census 82 standing (41.4%) -> 120 standing (60.6%). Verdict artifact verdict-20260908T153550-70df7db84b66.json: both criteria pass, all four hypotheses confirmed. WHAT A READER SHOULD KNOW IN A YEAR: the two proofs that separated (test_nest.py, test_transitions.py) sit in the SAME directory, which is why the directory recipe could never have told them apart.

window.note: An exemption written in code stands only if it cites a ruling or states an impossibility. MEASURED AT BUILDME, by direct reading rather than grep: SEVEN exemption sites in the live tree. (a) inspector.py _DEVICE_ISOLATION exempt=('db_domain',) — cites ruling 2026-08-31-no-cross-device-imports. (b) address_rule.exemption_of — two impossibility reasons, prose in a docstring. (c) transitions._EXEMPT_ROSTER and (d) _CLEARANCE_EXEMPT_ROSTER — both frozenset(), ZERO members, reasons in comments. (e) watchme_spec — two exemptions stated as one rule, citing Akien's 2026-08-03 ruling, prose. (f) bus_client probe _EXEMPT_SEGMENTS + RUNNER_ROSTER — nothing machine-readable. (g) hollow.py skips any path under proofs/ — reason is a module constant, not attached as a justification. FIVE of seven carry a reason no checker can read. ALSO MEASURED: no cairn/machines/exemptions directory; find for exemption*set* returns zero; the SIEVES table holds 33 names and none contains 'exempt'. The inherited '187 exemptions' is a PHANTOM — traced in the ruling to a conflation with 187 history.json entries carrying proven_by. The real population is single digits, which is what the ruling predicted. SCOPE CUT, made without escalating: 'exemption' names two populations. The 326 `none, because <X>` reasons on filed tickets are OUT — they have their own floor (reason_has_referent, inspector.py:1938) answering a different question. The seven code sites where a check declines to run are IN. DETERMINISM IS THE DESIGN, per Akien's standing rule that nothing in inspectors or gates may be LLM: each set entry declares its justification KIND — 'ruling' with a decision id, or 'no-other-way' with a stated impossibility — and the sieve checks only that the declared kind's evidence resolves. It never reads English to decide which kind applies, and it never judges the quality of a no-other-way statement.
